text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To Orfe. You received more gifts
from the students who adore you.
I've already inspected all the contents, naturally."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ho... quite a lot of sweets.
There are tea leaves too, I see... Hmm, shall we brew some tea?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...What a lovely aroma.
These sweets also have a remarkably refined texture.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that.
Would you care for another cup?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
...Perhaps I should bestow a reward upon whoever sent this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall write a piece myself.
You there, bring forth writing tools.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, savoring the gifts from the students who admired her, Orfevre spent a wonderful day off.
